author: Arachadonic
body:
I see people constantly advertising youtube channels, youtube videos and twitch streams that have 0 to do with this server, both here on the forums and ingame. I feel that this is wrong and often I see videos advertised that are filmed on other servers which is basically advertising!

I propose a rule like this:
  • Any form of media advertising, e.g SocialMedia, Youtube, Twitch, that does not relate directly to the Avicus Network is punishable.
I see there is already this rule which is kind of similar however it is not enforced at all. So I really think it should be enforced more even if my version isn't added:



EDIT: Nevermind the rule covers it and even funky said it here: http://avicus.net/forums/b85a57986 
Staff need to start enforcing this then or remove the rule.
